title: patch_file fails on old_string containing Unicode special characters (en-dash U+2013)
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' when attempting to replace a block containing the Unicode en-dash character (U+2013, used in 'steps 3-4'). The grep_files tool correctly located the text at the expected line, confirming the content exists. The failure appears to be a character encoding mismatch between the old_string argument and the file content during exact-string matching. Required falling back to write_file for the complete run.skill.md rewrite.
proposed_resolution: Normalize Unicode special characters in patch_file's exact-string matching by comparing normalized forms (NFC/NFD) or by stripping/replacing common Unicode punctuation (en-dash, em-dash, smart quotes) with their ASCII equivalents during the matching phase. Alternatively, document clearly that patch_file requires pure ASCII in old_string and fail with a descriptive error when non-ASCII characters are present.
